subtitle: Discover cities, universities and opportunities around the world.

hint.title: Start with a country
hint.body: Spin the globe and tap a country to see its cities. Colombia has the richest catalog for now.

intro.title: Your future has more than one route.
intro.lead: Tell us one thing and we will help you look at the world from where you actually are, not from where everyone else is.
intro.question: How open are you to studying in another country?

options.yes_if_viable: Yes, if I find something workable
options.maybe: Maybe, I am still thinking about it
options.prefer_home: For now I would rather study in my own country

destinations.title: Destinations for you
destinations.strong: Fits what you are looking for
destinations.strongHelp: It matches what you told us: language, country, or how open you are to leaving.
destinations.exploreHelp: There is somewhere to study, but something here is for you to check.
destinations.caveat: This is not an admission guarantee or immigration advice. It is what your profile suggests exploring; always verify requirements, costs, and visas with the institution.

reasons.language: taught in {{language}}, a language you already have
reasons.targetCountry: it is in {{country}}, the country you set as your goal
reasons.home: it is in {{country}}, and for now you would rather stay
reasons.checkCosts: we do not have its costs yet

noCities.title: {{country}} has no cities in FuturePilot yet
noCities.imported: We have {{count}} universities on record for this country, but not its cities or cost of living yet. We are starting with the Americas.
noCities.unknown: We have no data for this territory. It is not a study destination we track.

guide.title: This is a map of your options.
guide.lead: Every country on the globe has cities, and every city has universities, degrees, and what it costs to live there. There is nothing to memorise: you explore by tapping.

rotate.title: Spin the globe and tap a country
rotate.body: Drag to spin it. Tapping a country opens up its cities.

city.title: Open a city
city.body: There you see its universities, which degrees they offer, and the cost of living, in minimum wages so that the number actually means something.

save.title: Keep whatever is useful
save.body: The cities and careers you care about stay in your passport and your flight plan, so when you come back you pick up where you left off.

guide.note: Colombia has the most complete catalogue for now. In other countries you will find fewer cities: they are being filled in.
